googleImagesAccess: Opened and visually inspected in the in-app browser
method: Visual review of Google Images results and image-search descriptions; no source image pixels copied
observations: Image results emphasize friendly fan-tail bird characters, natural-history side views, black-and-white coloring outlines, transparent cutouts and roasted-turkey food art.
Search results show many near-identical frontal cartoon turkeys. A useful collection needs distinct poses, age groups, natural behaviors, classroom diagrams and craft-friendly negative space.
designDecisions: Original bird anatomy and feather structure; no copying of stock silhouettes or poses.
Mix editorially distinct naturalistic, friendly illustrated and outline uses; each asset gets a composition and use case.
Create isolated transparent subjects, avoid inaccurate extra legs or feet and culture-themed costumes.
The term turkey refers to the bird; cooked-dinner illustrations are a small separate subset, clearly titled.
